JAH-SCAV-000197.description: The audio trail: the podcast hunt.
JAH-SCAV-000197.content:
The Podcast Scavenger — The audio trail: the podcast hunt.

The podcast scavenger follows the audio trail: the players find the moments in the episodes — the timestamp, the quote, the guest.

The hunt's list is the listening: the episode, the minute, the words. The technique is the shownotes and the speed-listen.

The hunt's pleasure is the deep cut: the moment only the careful hear. The scavenger's rule is the attribution — credit the show.

Key points:
- Find moments: timestamp, quote, guest.
- Shownotes and speed-listening.
- Score the deep cuts.
- Credit the shows.

JAH-SCAV-000198.title: The Forum Archaeology Dig
JAH-SCAV-000198.description: The old threads: the forum excavation.
JAH-SCAV-000198.content:
The Forum Archaeology Dig — The old threads: the forum excavation.

The forum archaeology dig excavates the old threads: the players find the ancient posts — the first question, the legendary answer, the thread that never died.

The hunt's skill is the search: the date filters, the advanced operators, the patience. The scoring favors the legendary finds.

The hunt's lesson is the community's memory: the forum remembers what the web forgot. The dig's rule is the respect — the posters are people.

Key points:
- Excavate ancient threads.
- Date filters and operators.
- Score legendary finds.
- The posters are people.

JAH-SCAV-000199.title: The Webcam Wildlife Watch
JAH-SCAV-000199.description: The live wild: the webcam hunt.
JAH-SCAV-000199.content:
The Webcam Wildlife Watch — The live wild: the webcam hunt.

The webcam wildlife watch hunts the live wild: the players spot the animals on the public webcams — the eagle's nest, the watering hole, the reef cam.

The hunt's list is the watching: the cam, the species, the screenshot. The technique is the patience and the timezone math.

The hunt's joy is the live: the wild, happening now. The watch's rule is the non-disturbance — the watching never touches.

Key points:
- Spot animals on public webcams.
- Cam, species, screenshot.
- Patience and timezone math.
- Watching never touches.

JAH-SCAV-000200.title: The Online Huntmaster's Code
JAH-SCAV-000200.description: The capstone: running hunts online well.
JAH-SCAV-000200.content:
The Online Huntmaster's Code — The capstone: running hunts online well.

The online huntmaster's code is the capstone: the craft of the great online hunt. The code's chapters are the design (the chain of finds), the tech (the tested links), and the care (the safety briefing).

The code's rules are the tested: every link checked, every clue test-solved, every leaderboard fair.

The code's spirit is the invisible organizer: the hunt feels like magic because the work was done. The huntmaster's code makes the magic.

Key points:
- Design the chain; test the tech.
- Every link checked, every clue solved.
- Safety briefing always.
- Invisible organizer, magical hunt.
